prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1004; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, if that's all right. You can reference the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in League City, Texas. I was turning left onto a side street.

Q: What were you driving at the time?

A: My sedan. It was about a year old.

Q: Walk me through what happened as you began your turn.

A: I had the green light. I waited for a gap in the oncoming traffic, then started the turn. I saw a pickup coming toward me, but it looked like it would stop. It didn't.

Q: Did you have a chance to brake or swerve?

A: Not really. I hit the brake, but the impact came almost right away. My hands were on the wheel and my left wrist took most of the force when the airbag deployed.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any pain or injury right after?

A: My wrist hurt immediately. I couldn't move my fingers well. The paramedics took me to the hospital, and they said it was fractured.

Q: Has the doctor given you a treatment plan?

A: Yes, a cast for now, and I have a follow-up with an orthopedic specialist. I may need surgery depending on how it heals.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was driving carefully and I believe the other driver should have yielded. That's all I have.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
